description: This source file defines a Composable screen named VoiceTabScreen used in an Android application to handle voice interactions, including microphone controls, speaker toggles, and displaying conversation bubbles within a Compose UI framework.

classes.name: VoiceTurnBubble
classes.description: A composable that displays individual voice conversation entries, distinguishing between user and assistant messages with styling.

classes.name: VoiceThinkingBubble
classes.description: A composable that shows a 'thinking...' indicator during processing.

classes.name: ThinkingDots
classes.description: A decorative composable showing animated dots to indicate loading or thinking.

classes.name: ThinkingDot
classes.description: A small circle used within ThinkingDots for animation effect.

methods.name: VoiceTabScreen
methods.description: Main composable function implementing the voice interaction UI, handling permissions, state, and interactions.

methods.name: VoiceTurnBubble
methods.description: Displays a single turn in the conversation, styled based on the role (user or assistant).

methods.name: VoiceThinkingBubble
methods.description: Displays a 'thinking' indicator bubble in the conversation.

methods.name: ThinkingDot
methods.description: A small animated dot for the thinking indicator.

methods.description: Checks if the app has RECORD_AUDIO permission.

methods.name: openAppSettings
